LIST dp, k, h, a FROM Major m has MajorDepartment dp AND ALSO has MajorCollege c AND ALSO OPTIONALLY m is of Member mem AND ALSO nullif(m, if(coalesce(mem, '') = '', m, '')) AS hm AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF m GROUPED BY dp AS k AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF hm GROUPED BY dp AS h AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF mem GROUPED BY dp AS mc AND ALSO round(mc * 1.0 / k, 2) AS a WHERE c = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'

DEFINE MemDues ::= LIST mem, t FROM Member mem [has MemberPosition: 'Member'] [is of Event] AND ALSO is of Income i [has IncomeSource: 'Dues'] AND ALSO i has IncomeAmount a AND ALSO THE SUM OF a GROUPED BY mem AS t
LIST dp, s FROM Major m has MajorDepartment dp AND ALSO has MajorCollege c AND ALSO OPTIONALLY m is of Member mem AND ALSO OPTIONALLY mem has MemDues MemDuesT t AND ALSO coalesce(t, 0) AS x AND ALSO THE SUM OF x GROUPED BY dp AS s WHERE c = 'College of Engineering'
